$comment: Balanced hybrid preset for a machine with BOTH OpenAI and OpenCode Go providers. OpenAI for reasoning/knowledge/vision (orchestrator, oracle, designer); OpenCode Go deepseek-v4.1-flash for the high-volume cheap lanes (explorer, librarian, fixer). Agent selection rationale in standalone-agents/README.md 'Balanced hybrid'. Apply with: ./setup.sh --preset hybrid. Agents not listed follow the global model.
